description: Participated on 5th Indian Youth Science Congress, 6-9 December 2013, Shantiniketan, West Bengal.
Participated on National Youth Convention on Attracting and Retaining Youth in Agriculture (ARYA), 27th January, 2016, NASC Complex, New Delhi.
Presented at 72nd Annual Conference of the Indian Society of Agricultural Statistics, 13-15 December, 2018, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.
111th FOCARS (Foundation Course for Agricultural Research Services) Foundation training at ICAR-NAARM, Hyderabad. (05th Oct, 2020 to 02nd January, 2021)

Participated in 2 days boot camp on the theme “One Day-One App” on Zerocode platform a visual no code technology to swiftly develop Web & Mobile applications at ICAR-NAARM, Hyderabad (18th December to 19th December, 2021)
Orientation Training at ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi. (22nd January to 21st February, 2021)
Three months Professional Attachment Training at IIRS/ISRO, Dehradun (1st March to 31st May, 2021)

Participated in Hindi Workshop on “Application of Sampling Techniques in Agriculture and Data Analysis” conducted during 30 November to 2 December, 2021 at ICAR-Indian Agricultural Statistics Research Institute, Pusa, New Delhi (Hindi).

Attended in virtual international symposium on "Data Driven Agriculture and Natural Resource Management-Opportunities and Challenges" organized by Indian Society of Agricultural Information Technology (INSAIT) from 21-22 January, 2022.

Presented at 24th Annual Conference of SSCA (online) on “Recent Advances in Statistical Theory and Applications (RASTA-2022)” 23-27th February, 2022 at ICAR-National Academy of Agricultural Research Management (ICAR-NAARM), Hyderabad.
Participated in Online Training Programme on Geo-Spatial Analysis using QGIS & R (14th Feb to 19th Feb 2022) by ICAR-National Academy of Agricultural Research Management, Hyderabad.

Participated in ICAR Sponsored Winter School on “Application of Remote Sensing and GIS in Land Resource Management for Sustainable Agriculture Programme” from 02nd to 21st March, 2022 organized by ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning, Regional Centre, Kolkata.

Participated in Workshop on Some Quality Related Issues in Railway Track Maintenance & Timber Harvesting Management organized by Indian Association for Productivity, Quality & Reliability on 06th May, 2022.
Participated in Hindi workshop on “Experimental Design and Analysis” organized by ICAR-IASRI during 14-16 June 2022.
Presented at 73rd Annual Conference of ISAS on “Statistics and Machine Learning for Big Data Analytics” 14-16 November 2022, SKUAST-K, Kashmir, Srinagar, J&K, India.
Attend Online Workshop on “Statistical Meta-Analysis” on 19th June 2023 being organised by ICAR-IASRI.
